title: Bioschemas Sample properties
description: Properties of a biological sample from the Bioschemas Sample draft (https://bioschemas.org/), in the bios: namespace. A node using them is typed with bios:Sample beside its own type. Every property accepts one value or an array, because framing collapses a one-element array to its value. Ranges follow the Bioschemas draft where it gives one, and allow text where real records use text for a term.

bios:anatomicalStructure.description: The organ or tissue the sample was collected from.

bios:anatomicalSystem.description: The anatomical system the sample was collected from, e.g. circulatory, digestive, immune.

bios:associatedPhenotype.description: Defining characteristics expressed by the biological source of the sample.

bios:collectionMethod.description: Conditions and methods of acquisition of the sample.

bios:collector.description: The Person or Organization who collected the sample.

bios:dateCollected.description: The date the sample was collected.

bios:dateProcessed.description: The date the sample was processed or used in a method.

bios:developmentalStage.description: The age or developmental stage of the source when the sample was created, as a term or a quantity.

bios:environmentalSystem.description: The habitat or ecosystem where the sample was collected.

bios:experimentalPurpose.description: The planned or executed experimental procedures involving the sample.

bios:isControl.description: Whether the sample is used as a normal control.

bios:locationOfOrigin.description: The location from which the sample was originally collected.

bios:sampleAvailability.description: Whether the sample is available for reuse.

bios:sampleProcess.description: The processing technique applied to the sample.

bios:sampleState.description: The condition, composition or state of the sample, e.g. dried, frozen.

bios:sampleStorageTemperature.description: The temperature at which the sample is stored.

bios:sampleType.description: The type of sample, intentionally broad (cells, rock, sand).

bios:sex.description: The biological sex of the individual the sample was obtained from.

bios:studyID.description: The identifier of the study the sample belongs to.

bios:studyTitle.description: The title of the study the sample belongs to.

bios:project.description: The project the sample belongs to.

term.description: A defined term, or a reference to one. It must name or identify the term.

quantity.description: A schema:QuantitativeValue; a range uses minValue and maxValue.
